catch_tower.anchor: centre of its base on the ground, face toward the rocket on -x
catch_tower.notes: tower = catch. body.y to (mount top + 1.05 H) / 26; pose_carriage moves in y; chopsticks turn about y.

crew_arm.anchor: the hinge on the tower face, 0.7 m below the walkway floor (attach_floor); ship on -x
crew_arm.notes: access = arm. Scale walkway in x to (gap - 1.5 m); white_room sits at its end; pose_arm turns about y.

egress.anchor: nodes placed by art.js (basket: its origin on the wire; bunker on the ground)
egress.notes: access = slidewire (basket, bunker); blastroom uses bunker.

holddown.anchor: each node on its own base (heads at the grip height); the rocket on -x of it
holddown.notes: clamps = hold (clamp_*), release (arm_saturn_*); tower = tsm and platform TSMs (tsm). Columns stretch in y.

lightning_tower.anchor: centre of its base on the ground; real size
lightning_tower.notes: lightning = mast / catenary. Real size; wires from attach_wire.

ml1.anchor: rocket axis at the pedestals' feet (the trench hardstand); tower on +x
ml1.notes: mount = mlp at LC-39B (NASA ML-1). Scale tower.y to the 1.10 H rule; the base keeps its height.

mlp_saturn.anchor: rocket axis, at the pedestals' feet (the trench hardstand)
mlp_saturn.notes: mount = mlp with a tower on the deck (Saturn V). tower_fixed stands at attach_tower.

mlp_shuttle.anchor: rocket axis, at the pedestals' feet (the trench hardstand)
mlp_shuttle.notes: mount = mlp with the tower on the pad (Shuttle era). Hide node posts when the ship has no strap-ons.

mount_olm2.notes: mount = raised at Starbase Pad 2 (flame trench, no plate).

mount_raised.notes: mount = raised (Starbase Pad 1). Hide node plate when the pad has no water.

mst.anchor: centre of its base (the ship axis when closed round it); doors on -x
mst.notes: tower = mst. body.y to 1.15 H; head rides on top; doors pose_door_a/b about y; bogies stay.

pedestal_lc34.notes: mount = pedestal at LC-34. deflector_wedge rolls on its rails (-x).

pit.notes: mount = deflector (flame pit). soyuz_launcher stands on attach_ring.

rss.anchor: the hinge column foot; mated, the box runs along -x beside the ship (+z side faces it)
rss.notes: tower = rss (with tower_fixed). pose_rss turns about y on the hinge; rail is a 120 deg arc.

slab.notes: mount = slab. The ship stands on attach_deck.

soyuz_gantry.anchor: centre of its base, face toward the rocket on -x (one half)
soyuz_gantry.notes: tower = gantry: two copies (turned 180 deg about the ship). Hinge at attach_hinge (outer foot), turn about z.

soyuz_launcher.anchor: rocket axis, 1.8 m below the ring top (attach_ring, where the ship stands)
soyuz_launcher.notes: clamps = tulip. pose_arm_k: hinge 0.3 m above the ring, local +x outward; rotate about local z (negative opens).

sphere.anchor: centre of its base on the ground; real size
sphere.notes: propellant = auto / loadgo: LH2, Pad 39B (1.25 M gal). Real size.

sphere_lox.anchor: centre of its base on the ground; real size
sphere_lox.notes: propellant = auto / loadgo: LOX, LC-39 (900,000 gal). Real size.

strongback.anchor: centre of its foot, face toward the rocket on -x
strongback.notes: tower = strongback. pose_frame turns about z on the hinge (-4 deg = leaned back); scale body.y to 1.02 H.

table_ela3.notes: mount = mlp at ELA-3 (table on the duct). Hide node masts if a tower serves the ship.

tower_fixed.anchor: centre of its base on its deck, face toward the rocket on -x
tower_fixed.notes: tower = fixed (and under rss). Scale body.y to the 1.10 H rule; head and top_mast ride on the top; arms by art.

trench.notes: mount = trench (with node table) or under mlp / ml1 (hide table). Show one of deflector_wedge, deflector_ramp.

water_tower.anchor: centre of its base on the ground; real size
water_tower.notes: deluge = tower (and iop). Real size: place by the far-field rule.

weather_gear.anchor: nodes placed by art.js, each on its own base
